policy: A track must be status=allowed with a licence somebody can produce before it can be a bed. 'own' needs no URL — there is no licence page for something the channel made. Everything else needs source_url, because a licence you cannot point at is one you cannot produce when a Content ID claim arrives. Unverified files stay on disk: deleting the evidence of what was used is worse than blocking it. Audited by brand/music.py audit(), quarterly per the editorial calendar.

tracks.title: Journey to the Golden Temple
tracks.notes: BLOCKED by the 2026-09-17 audit. Was allowed under 'recorded-in-project', which is a note rather than a licence — a third-party track by tokyorifft with nothing to produce if a claim lands on the Ganapathi film. It is still on disk and still the proven instrumental for Line B/C devotional edits. TO RE-ENABLE: find where it was licensed from, paste that page into source_url, set licence to the actual terms (cc / licensed / public-domain) and status back to allowed. One line, and then it is defensible.
